notes: Heat on the L-shaped domain of l_shape_adaptive: u = (1 - exp(-t)) r^(2/3) sin(2 theta / 3) is the exact solution of u_t - lap(u) = exp(-t) r^(2/3) sin(2 theta / 3), starting from u = 0, so the corner singularity grows in time. Solved adaptively in time from a 28-node mesh: every 5 steps the residual estimator marks the triangles where the error is (Dorfler, theta = 0.5), newest vertex bisection refines them and the solution is moved to the new mesh by interpolation. The refinement gathers at the re-entrant corner; at t = 2 the L2 error on about 5600 nodes is about a fifth of a uniform mesh's with 6200 nodes. Each snapshot is shown on its own mesh; the exact solution is in view.exact_solution, so the Solve step compares every snapshot.

geometry.name: l_shape.svg
geometry.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="-1.1 -1.1 2.2 2.2">
  <!-- An L: the square [-1, 1]^2 without the quarter x > 0, y < 0 (SVG's
       y points down; the app flips it, so y < 0 is y > 0 here). The two
       edges at the re-entrant corner (0, 0) are one region. -->
  <path data-region="corner" d="M 0 0 L 1 0" fill="none" stroke="#eb6834" stroke-width="0.02"/>
  <path data-region="outer" d="M 1 0 L 1 -1 L -1 -1 L -1 1 L 0 1" fill="none" stroke="#2a78d6" stroke-width="0.02"/>
  <path data-region="corner" d="M 0 1 L 0 0" fill="none" stroke="#eb6834" stroke-width="0.02"/>
</svg>

equation.text: u_t - lap(u) = exp(-t) * (x^2 + y^2)^(1/3) * sin(2/3 * Piecewise((atan(y/x), x > 0), (atan(y/x) + pi, x < 0), (pi/2, y > 0), (3*pi/2, True)))

outer.text: u = (1 - exp(-t)) * (x^2 + y^2)^(1/3) * sin(2/3 * Piecewise((atan(y/x), x > 0), (atan(y/x) + pi, x < 0), (pi/2, y > 0), (3*pi/2, True)))

view.exact_solution: (1 - exp(-t)) * (x^2 + y^2)^(1/3) * sin(2/3 * Piecewise((atan(y/x), x > 0), (atan(y/x) + pi, x < 0), (pi/2, y > 0), (3*pi/2, True)))
